meaning: M31's stars from the Local Group Galaxies Survey as dots on its photograph's disc, after the Gaia foreground cut, thinned evenly so the renderer can draw them: denser where the galaxy has more stars.

banks.basis: Presentation choice: only where the photograph is (the image layers' 27.2 kpc support radius, recipe.json), and one star in 71 in catalogue order, which keeps 4,969 of 352,752 within the renderer's 5,000-dot bank and thins every region alike, so the density contrast stays the survey's.

colourTowardWhiteBasis: Presentation choice: the Milky Way and M31 dots' value (milky-way/source/local-3kpc/merge.json), so every galaxy's dots read as the same tints of starlight.
colourGammaBasis: Presentation choice: the Milky Way and M31 dots' value (milky-way/source/local-3kpc/merge.json).
